selection.policy: 按普通内容、分类多链接、搜索结果、最近浏览或产品选购选型，再核对布局、背景与设备。当前十个精确调用含描边通栏、嵌入详情和完整产品卡；侧栏仍参考。Card真实引用List、Tag和Cart；仅按allowedEdits修改内容，不自动扩展移动端或业务请求。 Current five-variant closure 20261115: only supported exact source examples and publication decisions permit local calls. Earlier preview-only or placeholder descriptions are historical; PC geometry and host boundaries remain explicit.

identity.rule: Complete actual image + body, selected stack/meta/description wrappers, and real inline-black/M TextButton. No Preview inline sizing, placeholder media or fictitious action child. Bordered horizontal auto-call withdrawn pending scrollbar/tall-content and visual verification; vertical metadata is category plaintext. Current vertical requires data-card-current=vertical-single-event.
identity.assetRule: Default existing engineering photo is demo/page content, not a design-system icon or MG component asset. Rebase relative image/icon paths when assembled elsewhere.
